title: Angles in triangles and with parallel lines

widget.instructions: Drag corner B or use the slider to change the angles.

steps.text: Change the angle at A: the angle at B changes too, because the three angles of a triangle always add to 180°.
Here C is 90°, so A + B = 90°.
When a line crosses two parallel lines, alternate angles (a Z shape) are equal and co-interior angles (a C shape) add to 180°.
Tear off the three corners of any triangle and put them side by side: they make a straight line, 180°.
That is why the third angle is 180° minus the other two.

recap.text: Recap: triangle angles add to 180°; alternate angles are equal.

accessibility.altText: A right triangle whose angle can be changed.
accessibility.nonDragAlternative: Use the angle slider and the buttons; the description gives every angle.
